name: blauos-hello
summary: Tiny repo-native demo payload for guest package-manager acceptance: prints a marker line; packaged as a signed .bpm and installed/verified/removed by bpm in the VirtualBuddy guest.

license.notes: Repo-native fixture (vm/commands/bpm/hello.c); the repository's own MIT license applies per the root LICENSE file.

isolation: Compiles one repo-native C file against the independently built runtime with the pinned SDK profile (libSystem-only link, verified by otool in the builder). The workspace source pin is a content hash of the tracked file, validated by scripts/build/packages.py.

rebuild.note: Pins are validated by scripts/build/packages.py. Guest install acceptance is recorded in evidence/virtualization/package-manager; a clean-environment rebuild comparison is remaining work.
